title: Three-axis Gyroscope
text: Implement three-axis gyroscope, 2 inputs, 1 output; {Second order dynamics} sets the second-order, {Natural frequency (rad/sec)}, {Damping ratio}, {Scale factors and cross-coupling} scales factors and cross coupling {Measurement bias}, {G-sensitive bias} sets the maximum change in rates, {Update rate (sec)}, {Noise on} sets the white noise, {Noise seeds}, {Noise power} and {Lower and upper output limits} sets the minimum and maximum values of angular rates. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Scale factors and cross-coupling
params.values: Scale factors and cross coupling [1 0 0; 0 1 0; 0 0 1] (default) | 3-by-3 matrix

params.name: G-sensitive bias
params.values: Maximum change in rates [0 0 0] (default) | three-element vector

params.name: Lower and upper output limits
params.values: Minimum and maximum values of angular rates [-inf -inf -inf inf inf inf] (default) | six-element vector
